question: Identify users who have posted at least one question with 'linear regression' in the title, own more than 2 posts in total, and have earned either a 'Teacher' or 'Supporter' badge. Return their display names along with the total number of comments on all their posts.

prediction.sql: SELECT u.XCL_055 AS display_name, COUNT(c.XCL_005) AS total_comments FROM users AS u LEFT JOIN posts AS p3 ON p3.XCL_033 = u.XCL_052 LEFT JOIN comments AS c ON c.XCL_006 = p3.XCL_026 WHERE u.XCL_052 IN (SELECT p.XCL_033 FROM posts AS p WHERE p.XCL_027 = 1 AND p.XCL_035 LIKE '%linear regression%') AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM posts AS p2 WHERE p2.XCL_033 = u.XCL_052) > 2 AND u.XCL_052 IN (SELECT b.XCL_002 FROM badges AS b WHERE b.XCL_003 IN ('Teacher', 'Supporter')) GROUP BY u.XCL_052, u.XCL_055

arguments.sql:
SELECT u.XCL_055 AS display_name, COUNT(c.XCL_005) AS total_comments
FROM users u
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM posts p
    WHERE p.XCL_033 = u.XCL_052
      AND p.XCL_027 = 1
      AND p.XCL_035 LIKE '%linear regression%'
)
AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM posts p2 WHERE p2.XCL_033 = u.XCL_052) > 2
AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM badges b
    WHERE b.XCL_002 = u.XCL_052
      AND b.XCL_003 IN ('Teacher', 'Supporter')
)
LEFT JOIN posts p3 ON p3.XCL_033 = u.XCL_052
LEFT JOIN comments c ON c.XCL_006 = p3.XCL_026
GROUP BY u.XCL_052, u.XCL_055

SELECT u.XCL_055 AS display_name, COUNT(c.XCL_005) AS total_comments
FROM users u
LEFT JOIN posts p3 ON p3.XCL_033 = u.XCL_052
LEFT JOIN comments c ON c.XCL_006 = p3.XCL_026
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM posts p
    WHERE p.XCL_033 = u.XCL_052
      AND p.XCL_027 = 1
      AND p.XCL_035 LIKE '%linear regression%'
)
AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM posts p2 WHERE p2.XCL_033 = u.XCL_052) > 2
AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM badges b
    WHERE b.XCL_002 = u.XCL_052
      AND b.XCL_003 IN ('Teacher', 'Supporter')
)
GROUP BY u.XCL_052, u.XCL_055

FROM users u
LEFT JOIN posts p3 ON p3.XCL_033 = u.XCL_052

WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM posts p

)
